DE.name: Sperrige Grindelie
DE.citation: heilpflanzenwissen.at, listing species-specific German names across the Grindelia genus (G. robusta = Kalifornisches Gummikraut, G. hirsutula = Haariges Gummikraut, G. squarrosa = Sperriges Gummikraut/Sperrige Grindelie). Note: the EU herbal monograph (Ph. Eur., HMPC) treats Grindeliae herba as officially, pharmaceutically interchangeable among G. robusta, G. squarrosa, G. humilis and G. camporum - a genuine, sanctioned multi-species drug source, not a naming error

US.name: Curlycup gumweed
US.citation: USDA NRCS Plant Database; Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center. Species-specific, distinguished from Grindelia camporum (Great Valley gumweed) and Grindelia stricta (Oregon gumweed). Used traditionally by Blackfeet, Pawnee, Cheyenne, Lakota/Dakota, Crow, Shoshone and Ponca peoples
